Learn to Skate USA membership required for Learn to Skate and hockey programs

blurb: Guests can participate in Learn to Skate programs for ages 3-12, hockey programs for various ages including adult and senior stick times, public skating sessions, and ice rink birthday parties. Programs run year-round with sessions typically lasting 4-6 weeks. Equipment rentals and training aides are included in some programs.
extraNote: Register early due to limits on skaters on the ice at one time · Drop-in hockey payments must be made at CMA front desk, no online registration for drop-ins
